en.name: Spartacus
en.ability: If an evil player guesses you (once), your team loses. You might register as a Townsfolk; each day, if you did not publicly claim to be Spartacus, you don't.

revisions.v1: If an evil player guesses you (once), your team loses. You might register as a Townsfolk; each day, if you did not publicly claim to be Spartacus, you don't.

en.flavor: "A man must not accept his fate. Or he will be destroyed by it." - Spartacus c. 103 B.C. - 71 B.C.

zh.name: 斯巴达克斯
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，任意邪恶玩家可以公开猜测你是斯巴达克斯，如果猜对，你的阵营落败。你可能会被当作镇民角色；每个白天，如果你没有公开声明自己是斯巴达克斯，你不会被当作镇民角色。
